name: SoftmaxFlashV3
note: FlashAttention-2 online softmax v3 (first block, isUpdate=false). Adds a mean/shift step over flashv2: rowMeanGlobal/mean computed, x shifted by alpha/(1-alpha) term, then max=rowmax, y=exp(x-max) (un-normalized), sum=rowsum(y). API forces src/dst=half, mean/sum/max=float. Device-side SoftMaxTilingFunc builds SoftMaxTiling; FlashV3 knobs in SoftMaxParams (splitMeanCnt=1 for K=64). x=0 -> dst all 1.0, mean=0, sum=64, max=0 (reduce block layout, col 0 of each 8-float block).
